Hot-air balloon: Which hot-air balloon is it?
Hot-air balloon. The board has 10x10 sites (160x160 cells). The window shows one site; each move goes to the next site (up, down, left or right). One large hot-air balloon fills the board on a blue sky. Four parts sit in their places, each drawn in black and each filling exactly one site: its two upper corners on the left and right: a pointed flap (a black triangle) or a round flap (a black disc); its two middle panels side by side at the centre: a black ring emblem or a black plus emblem; its ropes lower on the left and right: two straight ropes or two crossed ropes (an X); its basket at the bottom middle: a square basket or a cone basket (a black triangle pointing down). Every other site shows plain blue sky. The whole hot-air balloon may sit one site higher, lower, left or right. Question: Which hot-air balloon is it? The answer is one of eight hot-air balloons, each with its own parts: aurora = a round flap (a black disc), a black ring emblem, two straight ropes, a cone basket (a black triangle pointing down); breeze = a pointed flap (a black triangle), a black ring emblem, two crossed ropes (an X), a cone basket (a black triangle pointing down); cirrus = a round flap (a black disc), a black ring emblem, two crossed ropes (an X), a square basket; drift = a pointed flap (a black triangle), a black ring emblem, two straight ropes, a square basket; ember = a round flap (a black disc), a black plus emblem, two crossed ropes (an X), a cone basket (a black triangle pointing down); flare = a pointed flap (a black triangle), a black plus emblem, two crossed ropes (an X), a square basket; glide = a pointed flap (a black triangle), a black plus emblem, two straight ropes, a cone basket (a black triangle pointing down); haze = a round flap (a black disc), a black plus emblem, two straight ropes, a square basket. Answer with its name. You may answer at any time; you do not need to see every site. Score: 20 if the answer is right, minus 10, minus 0.1 per move (movement budget 35).
The answers: 1 = aurora, 2 = breeze, 3 = cirrus, 4 = drift, 5 = ember, 6 = flare, 7 = glide, 8 = haze.
